subject: Coord: Demo with Globex (AE+SE+IT Security) — timezone options

Cc: Diana Keller <diana.keller@globex.com>, security@globex.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Quick demo request — Globex trial

Hi Evelyn,

We kicked the tires on Redwood yesterday (self-serve) and would like a short walkthrough for our team. Core attendees will be me (PM, San Francisco), Diana Keller (IT Security, Frankfurt), and a couple of folks from infra (they're UK-based). Can you put together an AE+SE demo that covers:
- deployment options (private vs dedicated)
- audit/logging + SOC2 evidence
- basic latency/cost expectations for 2k reqs/day

We have a few timezone constraints next week: afternoons CET (14:00-17:00 CET) work best for Diana; for me late mornings PT are easiest (10:00-12:00 PT). Is there a slot that can bridge that window?

Thanks — happy to share a spreadsheet with exact names once we pencil something.

— Sam
Sam Knox
Product Manager, Globex Industries

Hi Sam — great to hear you started a trial, glad the timing worked.

We can absolutely run an AE+SE session and include the security-focused pieces. Jordan (SE) will take the deep-dive on observability/audit logs; I (AE) will cover deployment and cost tradeoffs. Jasmine will help coordinate the calendar and follow-up artifacts.

Two options that usually bridge PT/CET folks:
- Wed 2027-03-17 11:00 PT / 20:00 CET (60–75m) — later for Diana but often workable
- Thu 2027-03-18 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT (60–75m) — early for Sam but within your PT window if you can do mornings

If neither looks good, here is a Calendly with our combined availability; you can pick a slot and it will auto-add Jordan & me: https://calendly.com/redwood/45min-demo?month=2027-03

Agenda (draft):
1) Intros & success criteria (10m)
2) Deployment models + network/security controls (15m)
3) Observability, audit logs, retention (20m)
4) Q&A / next steps, procurement & timeline (15m)

I attached a short agenda and we'll bring the SOC2 artifacts during the call.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
